about: Roberto E. Blum attended law school and graduated from Texas Tech University School of Law in 2015. Roberto Blum began practicing law in 2015.
Roberto Blum is an attorney at Reyes Blum PLLC, helping people with Immigration: Consumer issues. Reyes Blum PLLC has an office in Houston, Texas, serving the local community.

Roberto Blum was selected to Rising Stars for 2022 - 2026. Rising Stars is an exclusive list of top-rated attorneys in specific practice areas who were chosen after thorough evaluation of numerous criteria.
